title: Why you WANT to use LinkedIn's "Open to Work" Banner
description:
Have you ever been reached out to from using the Open to Work banner? Let us know!  Does LinkedIn’s “Open to Work” banner make you look desperate? To *some yes, but to the RIGHT people absolutely not. The Open to Work banner is there to help and recruiters can actually use that toggle as a search filter when they go and look for candidates to reach out to. Just make sure your LinkedIn profile is up to date with experience, skills and keywords. #opentowork #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofilereview #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobseeker #newjobs
